Melitopil Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zaporizka oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Melitopil's Jewish population included 454 Karaites alongside 6,563 rabbinic Jews by 1897. During a 1905 pogrom, Jewish self-defense successfully stopped the rioting. An underground Lubavitch yeshiva operated in the city from 1938 to 1941, echoing a similar underground yeshiva documented at Dnipro elsewhere in this collection. Most of Melitopil's Jews evacuated before the German occupation in October 1941, though 1,800 remained and were murdered within a week of the Germans' arrival. The location of the town's second, older Jewish cemetery is unknown.
